articles.title_en: A general characterization of the minimum price Walrasian rule with reserve prices
articles.title_cn: 带保留价格的最低价格瓦尔拉斯规则的一般特征描述
articles.abstract_en: We consider economies consisting of arbitrary numbers of agents and objects, and study the multi-object allocation problem with monetary transfers. Each agent obtains at most one object (unit-demand), and has non-quasi-linear preferences, which accommodate income effects or nonlinear borrowing costs. The seller may derive benefit from objects. We show that on the non-quasi-linear domain, the minimum price Walrasian rule in which reserve prices are equal to the benefit the seller derives is the only rule satisfying four desirable properties; efficiency, individual rationality for the buyers, no-subsidy, and strategy-proofness. Moreover, we characterize the minimum price Walrasian rule by efficiency, overall individual rationality, and strategy-proofness.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑由任意数量的代理人和物品组成的经济体，并研究带有货币转移的多物品分配问题。每个代理人最多获得一件物品（单位需求），且具有非拟线性偏好，这可以容纳收入效应或非线性借贷成本。卖方可能从物品中获益。我们证明，在非拟线性域上，保留价格等于卖方获益的最低价格瓦尔拉斯规则是唯一满足四个理想性质的规则：效率、对买方的个体理性、无补贴和策略证明性。此外，我们通过效率、整体个体理性和策略证明性来刻画最低价格瓦尔拉斯规则。

articles.title_en: Credibility of group manipulation in random assignments
articles.title_cn: 随机分配中群体操纵的可信度
articles.abstract_en: For the random assignment problem, we introduce the notion of collusion-proofness that happens if the rule is immune to any collusion on misreporting preferences as it is either not profitable to form or profitable to betray. We characterize collusion-proofnessand prove that an assignment rule is collusion-proof if and only if it is strategy-proof and non-bossy. Therefore, the random serial dictatorship rule is immune to any collusive agreement between agents on preference misrepresentation, though it is not (weakly) group strategy-proof. This result gives us a possibility between collusion-proofness, ex-post Pareto efficiency, and equal treatment of equals. Furthermore, we proved that a large family of strategy-proof mechanisms called rank exchange mechanisms, à la Shende and Purohit (2023), are collusion-proof but group manipulable.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对随机分配问题，我们引入了共谋防范性的概念，当规则对任何关于虚报偏好的共谋具有免疫力时，即形成共谋无利可图或背叛共谋有利可图，则该规则具有共谋防范性。我们刻画了共谋防范性，并证明一个分配规则是共谋防范的当且仅当它是策略防范且非专断的。因此，随机序列独裁规则对任何代理人之间关于偏好虚报的共谋协议具有免疫力，尽管它并非（弱）群体策略防范。这一结果为我们提供了共谋防范性、事后帕累托效率和平等对待平等者之间的可能性。此外，我们证明了称为秩交换机制的一大类策略防范机制，即Shende和Purohit（2023）所提出的，是共谋防范的但可被群体操纵。

articles.abstract_en: We examine an economy in which interactions are more productive if agents can trust others to refrain from cheating. Some agents are scoundrels, who cheat at every opportunity, while others cheat only if the cost of cheating, a decreasing function of the proportion of cheaters, is sufficiently low. The economy exhibits multiple equilibria. As the proportion of scoundrels in the economy declines, the high-trust equilibrium can be disrupted by arbitrarily small perturbations or by arbitrarily small infusions of low-trust agents, while the low-trust equilibrium becomes impervious to perturbations and infusions of high-trust agents. Scoundrels may thus have the effect of making trust more robust.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察一个经济体，在该经济体中，如果代理人能够信任他人不进行欺骗，互动会更具生产力。一些代理人是无赖，他们抓住一切机会欺骗，而其他人仅在欺骗成本足够低时才会欺骗，该成本是欺骗者比例的递减函数。该经济体表现出多重均衡。随着经济中无赖比例下降，高信任均衡可能被任意小的扰动或任意小的低信任代理人注入所破坏，而低信任均衡则变得对扰动和高信任代理人的注入具有免疫力。因此，无赖可能具有使信任更加稳健的效果。

articles.title_en: On strategy-proofness and the salience of single-peakedness in a private goods allotment problem
articles.title_cn: 论策略性证明与私有物品分配问题中单峰性的显著性
articles.abstract_en: We consider strategy-proof rules operating on a rich domain of preference profiles in a set up where multiple private goods have to be assigned to a set of agents with entitlements and where preferences display satiation. We show that if the rule is in addition tops-only, same-sided and individually rational with respect to the entitlements, then the preferences in the domain have to satisfy a variant of single-peakedness (referred to as multi-dimensional single-peakedness relative to the entitlements). We also provide a converse of this main finding. It turns out that this domain coincides with the one already identified in a general set up with public goods. We relate the domain of multi-dimensional single-peaked preferences relative to the entitlements to well-known restricted domains with private goods under which non-trivial and strategy-proof rules do exist.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在多个私有物品必须分配给一组具有权利的代理人且偏好表现出饱和性的设置中，作用于丰富偏好域上的策略性证明规则。我们表明，如果该规则还满足仅依赖于顶部、同侧性以及相对于权利的个人理性，那么该域中的偏好必须满足单峰性的一种变体（称为相对于权利的多维单峰性）。我们还提供了这一主要发现的逆命题。结果表明，该域与在公共物品的一般设置中已经识别的域一致。我们将相对于权利的多维单峰偏好域与已知的私有物品受限域联系起来，在这些域中，非平凡且策略性证明的规则确实存在。
